title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We're excited to officially launch Spyglass, bringing you a powerful new tool designed to streamline your work and boost your productivity.

title: Enhanced File Management & Display
summary: Now you can effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the visual presentation of all your embedded files directly within the editor.

title: Unlock Our Vision: Introducing the Public Product Roadmap
summary: Now you can easily explore what we've recently accomplished, what's next on our journey, and what exciting features are planned for the future, all presented in one clear and accessible view.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our redesigned checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for effortless organization.

title: Enhanced Real-Time Collaboration
summary: Work together seamlessly with your team in real-time, now with clearer indicators and a significantly smoother co-editing experience.

title: Enhanced Collaboration and Shared Item Discovery
summary: We've made it significantly easier to find and collaborate on shared items, ensuring you always see what's relevant from your network.

title: Unlock Global Communication
summary: We're bringing Noeko to the world by adding robust support for multiple international languages.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now officially open source, empowering our community with unparalleled control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in its ongoing development.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity by filtering your constellation view by tags, time, and shared connections, transforming it into an indispensable workflow hub.

title: Powerful Search & Dynamic Collections
summary: Unlock precise knowledge navigation by filtering your search results with advanced options and saving custom collections for quick access to your most relevant content.

title: Flexible Connected Note Views
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to connect and display your notes, helping you structure your thoughts with greater flexibility.

title: Unlock Noeko's Full Potential with Flexible Hosting and Premium Access
summary: We are excited to launch Noeko's new plans, offering you the flexibility to host it your way and access powerful premium features tailored to your needs.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Enhanced Themes
summary: We're refreshing our current visual themes and introducing a vibrant collection of new options to provide a more personalized and stunning experience for your workspace.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our homepage to greet you with messages that precisely match the current time of day, creating a more personalized and thoughtful experience.

title: Supercharge Your Tagged Lists
summary: Gain immediate control over your content lists by performing essential bulk actions like unapplying tags, deleting entries, and viewing details, all from one convenient location.

title: Seamlessly Integrate Diverse Content Types
summary: We're expanding our platform to effortlessly support a broader range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you with a more comprehensive and flexible way to gather and manage your information.
